issues.title: Ingest Woodruff County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $7,073,572 across 34 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($2,488,413), County Road Fund ($2,112,065), Jail Operations ($843,675). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County General Fund
issues.detail: The ordinance table (p. 2) appropriates $2,488,412.58 to this fund. The line-item budget prints a fund total of $2,438,412.58 (p. 13), and its departments add to that: $50,000.00 less than the ordinance table. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
